  1 To-dos 4   2 Epics 6   3 All                 ◉ live |
 Keys and marks                                         |
                                                        |
 Move                                                   |
  j k        down, up; the arrows too                   |
  g G        top, bottom                                |
  Space      a page down; PgUp PgDn too                 |
  ^d ^u      half a page down, up                       |
  Tab 1 2 3  switch tab                                 |
  /          filter by title or id                      |
  p          this project, or every list                |
                                                        |
 Open                                                   |
  Enter      open full screen                           |
  l          unfold, step in, or open                   |
  h Esc      back; h on an epic folds it                |
  o          show the item's app link                   |
                                                        |
 Act                                                    |
 j k scroll  any other key close                1-18/43 |

== 140 x 20, layout b
  1 To-dos 4   2 Epics 6   3 All                                                                                                     ◉ live |
 Keys and marks                                                                                                                             |
                                                                                                                                            |
 Move                                          Act                                           Marks                                          |
  j k        down, up; the arrows too           x          done, or reopen                     ✓   your personal list                       |
  g G        top, bottom                        d          won't do, or delete a to-do        ABC  a project, in its colour                 |
  Space      a page down; PgUp PgDn too         s          snooze, then pick a time           ✦    a task an agent left for you             |
  ^d ^u      half a page down, up               u          undo the last change               ◦    Open: ready to start                     |
  Tab 1 2 3  switch tab                         y          copy id and title                  ◒    In progress                              |
  /          filter by title or id              Y          copy with details                  ⊘    Blocked                                  |
  p          this project, or every list                                                      ⊘    Waiting on another bead                  |
                                               App                                            ◌    Deferred, to a date when it has one      |
 Open                                           r          refresh                            ✓    Done, or Closed                          |
  Enter      open full screen                   ?          these keys                         ☾    snoozed                                  |
  l          unfold, step in, or open           q          quit                               ↻    repeats                                  |
  h Esc      back; h on an epic folds it                                                      ▰▰▱▱ an epic's closed tasks over all of       |
  o          show the item's app link                                                              them                                     |
                                                                                                                                            |
                                                                                                                                            |
 any key close                                                                                                                              |
